findings.highlight: so that I can go help her if she needs help
findings.evidenceJa: いつでも駆けつけられるようにしたい
findings.governingReading: he wants to remain able to rush to Sakura at any moment
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds a condition that Sakura must need or request help and weakens Shirou’s readiness to rush to her.

findings.highlight: Sakura is not the only one who is sick
findings.evidenceJa: 体調が優れないのは桜だけではありません
findings.governingReading: Sakura is not the only one in poor condition
findings.explanation: Saber’s broad assessment becomes a diagnosis of sickness.

findings.highlight: The extra time will help you replenish your magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方の魔力はいまだ満たされていない
findings.governingReading: his magical energy has still not been replenished
findings.explanation: A present deficiency becomes an added prediction about the benefit of extra time.

findings.highlight: You are not to push yourself
findings.evidenceJa: 桜同様、今夜は無理をせず休む事
findings.governingReading: like Sakura, he must avoid exertion and rest tonight
findings.explanation: The parallel between their conditions and the explicit rest instruction disappear.

findings.highlight: Saber reaches out for her tea
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーは居間に座って湯飲みに手を伸ばした
findings.governingReading: Saber sits in the living room and reaches for her teacup
findings.explanation: Her settled posture and the physical cup are omitted.

findings.highlight: eyes full of expectation
findings.evidenceJa: 拗ねたような、期待しているような
findings.governingReading: somewhat sulky and somewhat expectant
findings.explanation: Half of the deliberately mixed comic attitude disappears and is relocated solely to her eyes.

findings.highlight: I realize
findings.evidenceJa: 苦笑しながら
findings.governingReading: with a wry smile, he realizes
findings.explanation: Shirou’s amused response to Saber’s transparent request disappears.

findings.highlight: the stick of fire
findings.evidenceJa: 炎の鞭
findings.governingReading: a whip of flame
findings.explanation: The violent circuit image is mistranslated as a rigid stick.

findings.highlight: I sigh with relief
findings.evidenceJa: ほう、と大きく息を吐いた
findings.governingReading: he lets out a long, large breath
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds relief as the emotion and weakens the physical scale.

findings.highlight: I’ve skipped my daily routine for the past few days
findings.evidenceJa: ここのところ疎かにしていた日課
findings.governingReading: the daily exercise he has recently neglected
findings.explanation: Neglect becomes total omission on a newly specified run of days.

findings.highlight: activating my Magic Circuit
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術回路の形成
findings.governingReading: forming a magical circuit
findings.explanation: The source describes the learned act of constructing or establishing the circuit; mirror moon substitutes activation of a fixed circuit.

findings.highlight: The only weapon I can use has to be prepared beforehand using my “strengthening” magic
findings.evidenceJa: “強化”によって武器を用意しておく事しかできない
findings.governingReading: all he can do is prepare a weapon in advance through Reinforcement
findings.explanation: The restriction is on Shirou’s available response, not on a singular weapon being the only weapon he can use.

findings.highlight: maybe I’ll be able to do something
findings.evidenceJa: 活路も見えてくる
findings.governingReading: an avenue of survival may begin to appear
findings.explanation: The life-or-death tactical prospect becomes generic ability to act.

findings.highlight: how to quickly make a Magic Circuit
findings.evidenceJa: 効率のいい魔術回路の作り方
findings.governingReading: an efficient way to form magical circuits
findings.explanation: Efficiency is narrowed to speed and the recurring process is singularized.

findings.highlight: The person is walking slowly
findings.evidenceJa: ゆったりとした足音
findings.governingReading: unhurried footsteps
findings.explanation: A quality of the sound becomes an asserted walking speed.

findings.highlight: Sakura, who looks much better
findings.evidenceJa: ほのかに顔色の良くなった桜
findings.governingReading: Sakura, whose complexion has improved slightly
findings.explanation: A faint recovery sign becomes substantial improvement.

findings.highlight: It takes me completely by surprise
findings.evidenceJa: 正体不明のダメージ
findings.governingReading: an unidentified impact or damage strikes Shirou
findings.explanation: The comic physicalized effect of Sakura’s unfamiliar clothes becomes ordinary surprise.

findings.highlight: OhYeah, I’m awake
findings.evidenceJa: あああ、起きてる
findings.governingReading: Ah—yeah, I’m awake
findings.explanation: The fused interjection again produces malformed English and weakens Shirou’s fluster.

findings.highlight: That’s good
findings.evidenceJa: 良かった良かった
findings.governingReading: good, good—what a relief
findings.explanation: The repeated self-reassurance and warmth are reduced.

findings.highlight: This should warm up this place
findings.evidenceJa: 少しはあったかくなる
findings.governingReading: this should make things at least somewhat warmer
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds “this place” and loses the limited degree.

findings.highlight: So this was fixable
findings.evidenceJa: ちゃんと直ったんですね
findings.governingReading: you really did repair it properly
findings.explanation: Sakura praises a completed repair; the English only observes that repair was possible.

findings.highlight: I almost didn’t bother trying since it was so old
findings.evidenceJa: 直し始めの頃はあんまりにもオンボロなんで、さすがに無理だあー、ってサジ投げてた
findings.governingReading: after beginning the repair, he nearly gave up because it was such a wreck
findings.explanation: mirror moon changes abandoned effort after inspection into almost not trying and reduces decrepitude to age.

findings.highlight: Sakura’s criticizing me
findings.evidenceJa: 非難めいたコトを言っている
findings.governingReading: she is saying something that sounds almost reproachful
findings.explanation: A resemblance or tone is made categorical criticism.

findings.highlight: You were just as mad at me as at yourself
findings.evidenceJa: わたしと自分に怒ってて恐い顔してました
findings.governingReading: he wore a frightening face because he was angry at Sakura and himself
findings.explanation: The visible effect of Shirou’s anger disappears and “just as” adds equality.

findings.highlight: I really was sorry because I thought I did something awful
findings.evidenceJa: ほんとに悪いコトをしたんだなあって反省した
findings.governingReading: she reflected that she truly had done something wrong
findings.explanation: Sakura’s considered self-reflection becomes the feeling of being sorry.

findings.highlight: Sakura is perfectly composed
findings.evidenceJa: 桜は、すごく穏やかだ
findings.governingReading: Sakura is extraordinarily gentle and calm
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds perfection and shifts a warm quality toward self-control.

findings.highlight: she’s not merely putting on a strong face
findings.evidenceJa: いつもの『頑張ろう』って気を張っている桜じゃない
findings.governingReading: she is not the usual Sakura bracing herself with a determined “I’ll do my best”
findings.explanation: A contrast with Sakura’s habitual effort becomes a claim that her present face is not merely an act.

findings.highlight: I remember when I was a child
findings.evidenceJa: 少し子供の頃を思い出しちゃいました
findings.governingReading: it made her remember her childhood a little
findings.explanation: Degree and the present trigger disappear.

findings.highlight: if I didn’t say anything
findings.evidenceJa: ホントの気持ちを言わなければ
findings.governingReading: if she did not voice her true feelings
findings.explanation: Specific emotional concealment becomes complete silence.

findings.highlight: I didn’t want to worry anyone
findings.evidenceJa: 心配かけたくなくて
findings.governingReading: she did not want to cause others worry
findings.explanation: The source does not introduce an indefinite “anyone,” which loosens the family context.

findings.highlight: I don’t hear much
findings.evidenceJa: あんまり聞いたことない
findings.governingReading: she has not heard very much about his childhood
findings.explanation: Limited past exposure becomes an ongoing present habit.

findings.highlight: I get embarrassed, so I scratch my cheek
findings.evidenceJa: 照れ隠しに頬を掻く
findings.governingReading: he scratches his cheek to hide his embarrassment
findings.explanation: The gesture’s purpose changes from concealment to a mere consequence.

findings.highlight: Does it mean I’m a failure as a man
findings.evidenceJa: 男としてどうかと思った
findings.governingReading: he wonders what being wholly unchanged says about him as a man
findings.explanation: Self-conscious doubt becomes categorical failure.

findings.highlight: I thought I was patrolling the town
findings.evidenceJa: パトロールの真似事
findings.governingReading: a game or imitation of patrolling
findings.explanation: Childhood make-believe becomes a mistaken belief about what he was doing.

findings.highlight: people older than me
findings.evidenceJa: わずかに年上の連中
findings.governingReading: children only slightly older than him
findings.explanation: Age difference and peer context are broadened.

findings.highlight: a smart and devil-like person was in my age group
findings.evidenceJa: いたよーないなかったよーな
findings.governingReading: there may or may not have been a devilishly clever opponent his own age
findings.explanation: Shirou’s playful evasiveness becomes a factual assertion.

findings.highlight: reminds me of all the stupid things I did
findings.evidenceJa: 我が身を振り返っちまう
findings.governingReading: makes him look back critically at himself
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents that the remembered acts were stupid.

findings.highlight: someone to drag her outside
findings.evidenceJa: 手を取って外に連れ出してくれる人
findings.governingReading: someone to take her hand and lead her outside
findings.explanation: Supportive guidance becomes coercive dragging.

findings.highlight: might have trained Sakura every day
findings.evidenceJa: 毎日特訓してたかも
findings.governingReading: might have put Sakura through special training every day
findings.explanation: The exaggerated intensity of the childhood fantasy is weakened.

findings.highlight: I would’ve run
findings.evidenceJa: 元気だせー、って
findings.governingReading: calling “cheer up” as he took her along
findings.explanation: The imagined motive and Shirou’s direct encouragement disappear.

findings.highlight: I’m adopted
findings.evidenceJa: 切嗣の養子だぞ、俺
findings.governingReading: he is Kiritsugu’s adopted son
findings.explanation: The answer omits the adoptive parent whose relationship Sakura is asking about.

findings.highlight: a lot of things you didn’t like
findings.evidenceJa: いっぱいイヤなコトとかあった
findings.governingReading: many painful or unpleasant experiences
findings.explanation: Potential suffering becomes personal preference or dislike.

findings.highlight: did Fuji-nee give you the wrong idea
findings.evidenceJa: 藤ねえの入れ知恵だな
findings.governingReading: that line of thinking came from Taiga
findings.explanation: mirror moon asserts Taiga’s account was wrong rather than identifying her influence.

findings.highlight: it might’ve looked that way when I first came here
findings.evidenceJa: 初めの一年はそう見えたかもしんない
findings.governingReading: for the first year, it may have looked that way
findings.explanation: A full year of outward appearance becomes an unspecified initial moment.

findings.highlight: My first year here was spent healing my wounds
findings.evidenceJa: 傷が癒えるのに耐え続けた一年
findings.governingReading: a year spent continuing to endure while his wounds healed
findings.explanation: The prolonged act of endurance central to Shirou’s recovery disappears.

findings.highlight: I studied magic to be more like Kiritsugu
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術を習うために切嗣を追い掛け続けて
findings.governingReading: he kept pursuing Kiritsugu in order to learn magecraft
findings.explanation: mirror moon changes action, goal, and technical category, making resemblance the reason for studying.

findings.highlight: looking for the reason why only I survived
findings.evidenceJa: 一人だけ助かった意味を探して
findings.governingReading: searching for the meaning of having survived alone
findings.explanation: An existential search for meaning becomes a causal investigation.

findings.highlight: why only I survived that night
findings.evidenceJa: 一人だけ助かった意味
findings.governingReading: the meaning of his being the sole survivor
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds “that night,” narrowing a passage that already relies on the preceding fire reference.

findings.highlight: a superhero
findings.evidenceJa: 正義の味方
findings.governingReading: an ally or champion of justice
findings.explanation: The work’s central ideal is replaced by a generic Western comic-book category.

findings.highlight: I answer
findings.evidenceJa: 気持ちのまま断言した
findings.governingReading: he states it decisively exactly as he feels it
findings.explanation: The sincerity and certainty of Shirou’s answer disappear.

findings.highlight: It’s amazing that you’re so sure of yourself
findings.evidenceJa: まっすぐで、かっこいいです
findings.governingReading: he is straightforward and admirable or cool
findings.explanation: Sakura praises Shirou’s moral directness and character; mirror moon praises confidence.

findings.highlight: I usually get embarrassed from such words
findings.evidenceJa: いつもなら恥ずかしくて目を逸らす
findings.governingReading: normally embarrassment would make him avert his eyes
findings.explanation: The visible avoidance behavior disappears.

findings.highlight: her words hit me so much
findings.evidenceJa: 胸に届いた
findings.governingReading: her words reach his heart or chest
findings.explanation: A quiet emotional arrival becomes awkward forceful impact.

findings.highlight: I’d get more mad than anybody else
findings.evidenceJa: 他のヤツより何倍も怒る
findings.governingReading: he would be many times angrier with Sakura than with anyone else
findings.explanation: The English can mean Shirou would exceed other people’s anger rather than treating Sakura more sternly because she matters more.

findings.highlight: I’d want you to do that
findings.evidenceJa: 先輩になら、いいです
findings.governingReading: if it is Senpai, that is all right
findings.explanation: Sakura’s oblique acceptance and trust are promoted into an explicit desire to be scolded.

findings.highlight: Seeing her smile makes me think
findings.evidenceJa: 首をかしげる
findings.governingReading: he tilts his head at the sense that this happened before
findings.explanation: The bodily sign of incomplete recognition disappears.

findings.highlight: my memory fails me
findings.evidenceJa: 小首を傾げた
findings.governingReading: he cocks his head slightly because he cannot remember what it was
findings.explanation: An active puzzled gesture becomes a global failure of memory.

findings.highlight: I lie on my futon
findings.evidenceJa: 布団にもぐりこみ
findings.governingReading: he slips under the bedding
findings.explanation: mirror moon places Shirou on top of the futon rather than under it.

findings.highlight: In a sudden flash of insight, it comes back to me
findings.evidenceJa: ひっかかっていたものが取れた
findings.governingReading: the thing snagging at his mind comes free
findings.explanation: The tactile release completing the prior motif becomes a newly invented flash of insight.

findings.highlight: with obstinacy you would never expect from her
findings.evidenceJa: それまで知っていた桜からは想像もつかないほど
findings.governingReading: with a stubbornness unimaginable from the Sakura he had known until then
findings.explanation: The temporal contrast with his prior understanding of Sakura is weakened.

findings.highlight: I gave upwell, Sakura’s effort beat me to be exact
findings.evidenceJa: それに折れて正直、桜の一生懸命さに負けた
findings.governingReading: he yielded—or rather, was defeated by Sakura’s earnest persistence
findings.explanation: mirror moon exposes an unpunctuated correction and produces malformed English.

findings.highlight: the key to my house that I kept in the shed which Kiritsugu used to use
findings.evidenceJa: 土蔵に仕舞っておいた、切嗣が使っていた家の鍵
findings.governingReading: the house key Kiritsugu had used, which Shirou had stored in the shed
findings.explanation: English attachment makes it sound as though Kiritsugu used the shed or even that the house was stored there.

findings.highlight: such a gift
findings.evidenceJa: 合鍵なんてもの
findings.governingReading: a spare key of all things
findings.explanation: The exact household access Sakura believes an outsider cannot accept becomes a generic gift.

findings.highlight: Please feel free to use this
findings.evidenceJa: 好きにうちを使ってくれ
findings.governingReading: use the Emiya home however she likes
findings.explanation: The invitation into the household becomes permission to use the key as an object.

findings.highlight: always has a warm smile
findings.evidenceJa: いつも柔らかく微笑む
findings.governingReading: always smiles softly
findings.explanation: Texture and manner become emotional warmth.

findings.highlight: her smile looked satisfied
findings.evidenceJa: 満ち足りた笑顔
findings.governingReading: a fully contented or fulfilled smile
findings.explanation: The rare depth of fulfillment is weakened into satisfaction.
